errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not authorized for this instruction

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: MyBarPool is paused; nothing has moved

errors.name: GameNotScheduled
errors.msg: Game is not scheduled: the record is final or has been marked

errors.name: GameAlreadyMarked
errors.msg: Game is already marked; marks are irreversible

errors.name: KickoffInPast
errors.msg: Kickoff must be later than the current time

errors.name: KickoffOutOfBounds
errors.msg: Kickoff may not move more than 72 hours past the scheduled kickoff

errors.name: KickoffUpdateTooLate
errors.msg: Kickoff can no longer be updated: the recorded kickoff has passed

errors.name: QuarterOutOfOrder
errors.msg: Quarter must be the next unposted one (1 to 4, in order)

errors.name: QuarterTooSoon
errors.msg: Quarter posted sooner than 15 minutes after kickoff or the previous post

errors.name: ScoreDecreased
errors.msg: A cumulative score is lower than the previous post

errors.name: FinalFlagMismatch
errors.msg: is_final must be set on the fourth post only; had_overtime needs is_final

errors.name: GateKeyNotSigner
errors.msg: Gate key is not a signer

errors.name: IntegratorMismatch
errors.msg: Integrator and integrator fee do not match

errors.name: SponsorshipTooSmall
errors.msg: Sponsorship is below one box price

errors.name: VarMismatch
errors.msg: Var does not match the pool

errors.name: VarNotEntropy
errors.msg: Var is not an Entropy account

errors.name: VarProviderMismatch
errors.msg: Var provider does not match config

errors.name: InvalidGameKey
errors.msg: Invalid game key: week, team index or home == away

types.name: ConfigUpdated
docs: PROGRAM §7 `ConfigUpdated`: the full config snapshot after `initialize` or `update_config`.

types.name: GameKey
docs: PROGRAM §2 game key: season, week, home, away. Five bytes on the wire (`season` u16 LE,

fields.name: season
docs: The year the regular season starts in (2026 for the 2026–27 season).

fields.name: week
docs: 1–18 regular season; 19 Wild Card, 20 Divisional, 21 Conference Championships,
22 Super Bowl. Preseason, when enabled, is 101–103 so it can never collide.

fields.name: home
docs: Home team: index 0–31 into the frozen team table (PROGRAM §2).

fields.name: away
docs: Away team: index 0–31 into the frozen team table (PROGRAM §2).

types.name: GameMarked
docs: PROGRAM §7 `GameMarked`: the admin marked the record `Postponed`, `Cancelled` or `Suspended`.

types.name: GameRecord
docs: Seeds `["game", season u16 LE, week u8, home u8, away u8, scheduled_kickoff i64 LE]`, the
six `gameRecordSeeds` in `@mybarpool/shared` produces, in that order.

fields.name: key
docs: PROGRAM §2 game key; part of the seeds.

fields.name: scheduled_kickoff
docs: Seed value; never changes. The 72-hour update bound and the 30-day reclaim clock are
measured from this, never from `recorded_kickoff` (ARCHITECTURE › Trust model).

fields.name: recorded_kickoff
docs: Starts equal to `scheduled_kickoff`; moved by `update_kickoff`. Sales close at this time.

fields.name: home_score
docs: Cumulative home score at the end of Q1..Q3 and final (ARCHITECTURE › Payouts).

fields.name: posted_at
docs: Unix time each post landed; 0 until it does.

fields.name: final_had_overtime
docs: Informational, set on the final post.

fields.name: reserved
docs: PROGRAM §3 preamble: padding so fields can be appended without a migration.

types.name: GameStatus
docs: PROGRAM §3.2 `GameStatus`; the discriminant is the on-chain byte. PROGRAM §9: `Scheduled`
is the only live state; the other four are terminal.

types.name: InitializeParams
docs: Every PROGRAM §3.1 field except `admin` (the signer), `bump` and `reserved`.

fields.name: tokens
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `tokens`, by token index (0 SOL, 1 SKR, 2 ORE).

types.name: OverrideClosed
docs: PROGRAM §7 `OverrideClosed`: a `WalletOverride` was closed; carries the values that were
closed so an indexer needs no prior state.

fields.name: wallet
docs: The wallet whose override was closed.

types.name: OverrideSet
docs: PROGRAM §7 `OverrideSet`: a `WalletOverride` was created or updated.

fields.name: wallet
docs: The wallet the limits apply to.

types.name: PlatformConfig
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `PlatformConfig`: the account the rest of the program reads. 698 bytes.
Layout (offsets from the start of the account data): discriminator 0 (8); `admin` 8;

fields.name: admin
docs: PROGRAM §3.1: the Squads vault on mainnet. May not be the default pubkey.

fields.name: entropy_provider
docs: PROGRAM §3.1: the Entropy provider whose commits `set_var` accepts.

fields.name: fee_wallet
docs: PROGRAM §3.1: platform fee destination (SOL directly; SPL to its ATA).

fields.name: default_preset
docs: PROGRAM §3.1: which preset clients pre-select; initial 0.

fields.name: max_open_pools
docs: PROGRAM §3.1: open pools per creator per game; ≥ 1; initial 3.

fields.name: max_own_boxes
docs: PROGRAM §3.1: creator's boxes in own pool; 1–MAX_OWN_BOXES_ABSOLUTE; initial 5.

fields.name: preseason_enabled
docs: PROGRAM §3.1: initial false; `create_game` rejects weeks ≥ 101 when false.

fields.name: paused
docs: PROGRAM §3.1: when true, `create_pool`, `buy` and `sponsor` fail; nothing else is affected.

fields.name: tokens
docs: PROGRAM §3.1: indexed by token index (0 SOL, 1 SKR, 2 ORE).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Padding so fields can be appended without a migration.

fields.name: is_final
docs: True on the fourth post only.

types.name: TokenRule
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `TokenRule`: one per token index (0 SOL, 1 SKR, 2 ORE). 98 bytes.

fields.name: enabled
docs: Pools may be created in this token.

fields.name: mint
docs: The mint; `Pubkey::default()` for SOL and for a token whose mint is not yet known.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Base-unit decimals: 9 SOL, 11 ORE, SKR per mint.

fields.name: step
docs: Price step, base units; ≥ 1; `(max_price − min_price) % step == 0`.

fields.name: max_sponsorship
docs: Per-pool sponsorship cap, base units; initial `25 × max_price`.

types.name: UpdateConfigParams
docs: Every PROGRAM §3.1 field as an option; `None` leaves it unchanged.

fields.name: admin
docs: New `admin`; takes effect for the next instruction. May not be the default pubkey.

fields.name: platform_bps
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `platform_bps`; up or down, never above PLATFORM_BPS_MAX.

fields.name: tokens
docs: PROGRAM §3.1 `tokens`, by token index; `Some` replaces that rule whole.

types.name: WalletOverride
docs: `bump` 42. No `reserved` field (ARCHITECTURE › Open source names the pool and config

fields.name: wallet
docs: The wallet these limits apply to; also the PDA seed.

fields.name: max_open_pools
docs: Open pools per game for this wallet; ≥ 1.

fields.name: max_own_boxes
docs: Boxes in its own pool for this wallet; 1–MAX_OWN_BOXES_ABSOLUTE.

constants.name: CREATOR_BPS_MAX
docs: PROGRAM §1 `CREATOR_BPS_MAX`: ceiling on the creator base share.

constants.name: GAME_SEED
docs: PROGRAM §3.2 `GameRecord` seed prefix; season, week, home, away and scheduled kickoff follow.

constants.name: KICKOFF_UPDATE_BOUND
docs: PROGRAM §1 `KICKOFF_UPDATE_BOUND`: 72 hours; how far a recorded kickoff may move from the scheduled one.

constants.name: LANES
docs: PROGRAM §1 `LANES`: positions per axis; lane `l` holds digits at positions `l` and `l + 5`.

constants.name: MAX_OWN_BOXES_ABSOLUTE
docs: PROGRAM §1 `MAX_OWN_BOXES_ABSOLUTE`: upper bound on any configured creator box cap.

constants.name: MIN_QUARTER_SECONDS
docs: PROGRAM §1 `MIN_QUARTER_SECONDS`: a quarter's worth of football takes at least this long in real time.

constants.name: OVERRIDE_SEED
docs: PROGRAM §3.6 `WalletOverride` seed prefix; the wallet follows.

constants.name: PLATFORM_BPS_MAX
docs: PROGRAM §1 `PLATFORM_BPS_MAX`: ceiling on the platform share.

constants.name: PRESET_SPLITS
docs: PROGRAM §1 preset table in percent, indexed by `PayoutPreset as usize`.

constants.name: QUARTERS
docs: PROGRAM §1 `QUARTERS`: settlement periods; the fourth is the final score.

constants.name: RECLAIM_DELAY
docs: PROGRAM §1 `RECLAIM_DELAY`: 30 days; abandoned-pool reclaim opens this long after the scheduled kickoff.

constants.name: SOL_DECIMALS
docs: Native SOL (PROGRAM §2 token index 0): nine decimals.

constants.name: TOTAL_BPS_MAX
docs: PROGRAM §1 `TOTAL_BPS_MAX`: ceiling on platform + creator base + add-on budget.
